summary: Misamis Oriental 2nd District representative with 116 principal-authored bills. Authored an estate tax amnesty extension; co-authored DSWD crisis assistance, national minimum wage, electric-cooperative debt condonation, bank transparency, an anti-dynasty ban and a bill against employment discrimination of women.
caveat: Nearly all evidence is co-authored and may not reflect every provision. Gender bill is a single social issue and unscored.

economic.rationale: Co-authored crisis assistance (-2), minimum wage (-2) and cooperative debt condonation (-1) against an authored estate tax amnesty extension (+2). Co-authored, thin.
